visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Animation starts with a young man named Wang Xiang in a blue robe and a blue hair ribbon, smiling against a plain wall. Text overlays introduce him. The style is 2D digital animation with simple outlines and flat colors. (2) Scene shifts to a snowy night outside a solitary house. White particles fall across the screen against a dark, cloudy sky. Smoke rises from a chimney. The lighting is dim and cold, suggesting a harsh winter environment. (3) Inside the house, a woman lies in a bed with a blue patterned quilt. She looks pale with closed eyes and a white cloth on her forehead. Wang Xiang watches her, conveying concern through his wide eyes and slight frown. (4) Wang Xiang walks through a blizzard towards a frozen lake. He is shivering, with lines around him indicating cold. The background shows a dark silhouette of a house and fence amidst a swirling vortex of white snow. (5) Close-up of Wang Xiang's face as he tries to break the blue-toned ice with a dark grey rock. He grits his teeth in frustration. Text bubbles show his inner dialogue. Small white cracks appear on the ice surface. (6) Wang Xiang removes his robe, appearing shirtless with visible abdominal muscles. He looks determined. He then lies face-down on the blue ice, attempting to melt it. His face is pressed against the cold surface, eyes closed. (7) A close-up of his face shows he is frozen to the ice. His eyes are wide with panic, and his skin has a blueish tint. Tears and sweat are visible. He opens his mouth as if shouting for help. (8) Underneath the ice, several red fish with cartoonish eyes and crowns look up. They have expressive facial features. The underwater environment is filled with blue light and small bubbles rising toward the surface of the ice. (9) A large group of red fish swim rapidly upward. Speed lines and a white glow emphasize their motion. They strike the underside of the ice with force, causing large white shards to fly into the air. (10) Wang Xiang is sent flying into the air as the ice explodes. He lands on the snowy ground, panting heavily with a red blush on his cheeks. A few fish are visible on the ground near the newly formed hole. (11) Final scene shows Wang Xiang walking away happily, smiling with eyes closed. He wears his robe again and carries two large blue bags overflowing with red fish. The background is a bright, warm yellow gradient.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 晉朝有一個人叫王祥. (2) [Subtitle]: 家裡很窮. (3) [Subtitle]: 一年冬天 外面天寒地凍. (4) [Subtitle]: 王祥為了給生病 想吃魚的後母煮魚吃. [Variety]: 好想吃魚...喝魚湯. (5) [Subtitle]: 因此他歷經千辛萬苦前往了湖邊. (6) [Subtitle]: 但此時湖面早已結冰. (7) [Subtitle]: 王祥試了很多辦法都無法擊破冰層. [Variety]: 敲不破. (8) [Subtitle]: 最後，王祥脫掉了全身上下所有的衣服. (9) [Subtitle]: 趴在了結冰的湖面上. (10) [Subtitle]: 想用身上的體溫融化湖面上的冰. (11) [Subtitle]: 果不其然! [Variety]: !?. (12) [Subtitle]: 王祥的身體就被黏住了. (13) [Variety]: 誰來...救救我.... (14) [Subtitle]: 此時，湖面冰層下的魚發現了王祥. (15) [Subtitle]: 欸! 怎麼辦!? 有個人類被冰黏住了. (16) [Subtitle]: 呵呵~ 他那個好迷你喔~. (17) [Subtitle]: 欸你別亂看啦! 雖然我剛剛也差點以為是小蚯蚓. (18) [Subtitle]: 別廢話了各位!! 我們趕快來幫他脫困! (19) [Subtitle]: 大家用力衝!! 把冰撞破!! 救出這位人類!!. [Variety]: 喝啊!!. (20) [Variety]: 哈...哈...哈.... [Subtitle]: 我得救了嗎.... (21) [Subtitle]: 人類阿~ 不用太過感謝我們~. (22) [Subtitle]: 趕快幫我們回到湖裡面就可以... (23) [Subtitle]: 這...這一定是老天爺 看在我的孝心上給我的賞賜. (24) [Subtitle]: 我們家終於有魚可以吃啦!. (25) [Variety]: 乾...

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A calm, mid-pitched male voice provides professional narration over a soft, upbeat acoustic BGM with a steady tempo. The speech rate is moderate. There is no background noise, creating a clean studio-quality audio environment for the introduction. (2) The sound of a whistling wind enters the mix, adding an outdoor ambient layer. The BGM continues at a lower volume. The narrator's tone remains consistent as he describes the setting and the cold winter weather with clear articulation. (3) A woman's voice is heard, sounding weak and breathy, expressing a desire for fish. The BGM shifts to a slightly more sentimental tone. The narrator continues his story with moderate intensity, maintaining the linear narrative flow. (4) Heavy wind noise and the crunching sound of footsteps on snow dominate the audio track. The narrator's voice exhibits a slight strained quality to match the character's physical struggle. The BGM remains in the background as a rhythmic rhythmic bed. (5) Rhythmic, percussive thudding sounds represent a rock hitting ice. A vocal grunt from the male character is clearly heard. The BGM tempo feels faster as the character's frustration and physical effort increase toward a climax. (6) The audio features a comical shivering sound and the sound of skin sliding onto ice. The narrator's tone becomes more dramatic and playful. The ambient wind noise remains constant, emphasizing the cold temperature of the animated scene. (7) A tense musical riser builds up. The character's voice changes to a high-pitched, desperate plea for help. There are audible gasps and sharp inhalations. The sound design focuses on his vocal strain and panic as he gets stuck. (8) The audio shifts to a muffled, underwater acoustic texture. Different, high-pitched, and slightly silly voices represent the fish talking below the ice. They speak quickly with high emotional arousal and excitement. Small pop SFX accompany their movements. (9) A loud, energetic collective shout from a group of fish voices is heard. This is followed by a dramatic whooshing riser and a sharp, high-amplitude ice-shattering impact effect. The BGM stops abruptly to emphasize the visual explosion. (10) Heavy, rhythmic panting sounds follow the ice explosion. The narrator returns with a relieved and warm tone. The ambient wind returns at a lower volume. A soft, friendly vocal interaction occurs between the fish and the human character. (11) A bright, happy musical jingle begins. The man laughs and shouts with high positive valence and joy. The sound of plastic bags rustling is clearly heard. The audio ends with a sudden musical cut and a short, sharp vocalization.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a comedic animation that subverts the traditional Chinese folklore of 'Wang Xiang Melts Ice for Carp.' It uses a lighthearted, humorous tone to turn a story of extreme filial piety into a joke where the fish, who help the man, end up being taken home as food, resulting in a funny and unexpected betrayal.
